model.name: RbStrip
model.note: Custom element <rb-strip> — the R31.5 layout foundation (ordered row of compartments+bars). Owns layout+scroll+snap, NO content logic. R31.5.2 = renderDescriptors (this chain). R31.5.4 viewport-mode methods (applyViewportMode/observeContainer/focus-restore) attach to THIS SAME class under their own req/chain. Fresh uuid minted by req-eng per architect (holds none). Expert builds rb-strip.ts; re-point file if the path differs.
